cases.question: Give the final night survey plan: the assigned team, access point, instrument package, and post-run custody step.
cases.answer: Team Sable uses the North Orchard gate with the Helix-4 package, then transfers the sealed media case to Rhea Moon before noon.

truth_claims.claim: The assigned night survey team is Team Sable.
The approved access point is the North Orchard gate.
The selected instrument package is Helix-4.
The sealed media case is transferred to Rhea Moon before noon after the run.

turns.content: The final staffing sheet says: The assigned night survey team is Team Sable. It also records that the approved access point is the North Orchard gate. The east service door is for daytime deliveries only.
Team Umber rehearses at the East Orchard gate with daylight cameras; that exercise is separate from the night survey.
The signed equipment row states: The selected instrument package is Helix-4. Helix-2 remains the backup bench unit.
An older checklist pairs Team Sable with Helix-2 for a calibration drill, not the approved survey.
The custody instruction is final: The sealed media case is transferred to Rhea Moon before noon after the run. The empty equipment case returns to storage.
Rhea Moon receives an unrelated battery crate in the afternoon through the loading dock.

cases.question: For the coastal archive request identified by its amber seal and second-quarter window, what collection and delivery desk were selected?

The amber-seal second-quarter selector maps request key AX-42 to delivery Desk 7B. No collection name appears on this selector sheet.

cases.question: Which occurred first, the kiln inspection or the glaze shipment, and how many days separated them?
cases.answer: The kiln inspection occurred first, three days before the glaze shipment.

truth_claims.claim: The kiln inspection was completed on November 8.
The glaze shipment arrived on November 11.

turns.content: The kiln inspection was completed on November 8. The inspector's report was signed that evening.
Empty shipment pallets were counted on November 9, unrelated to glaze delivery.
The glaze shipment arrived on November 11. Inventory entry followed the same day.
A kiln cleaning finished on November 6, but it was not the inspection.
A clay shipment arrived on November 12.
The glaze invoice was archived on November 13.

cases.question: For row Q9 in the final seed ledger, report its bed, strain, watering cadence, and primary steward.
cases.answer: Q9 is in Bed Delta, uses strain Nimbus, is watered every 28 hours, and is stewarded by Inez Quill.

truth_claims.claim: Q9 is assigned to Bed Delta.
Q9 has primary steward Inez Quill.

turns.content:
Final ledger location rows:
Q8 | Bed Alpha
Q9 | Bed Delta
Q10 | Bed Gamma
The signed row meaning is: Q9 is assigned to Bed Delta.
Strain rows list Q8 as Cirrus, Q9 as Nimbus, and Q10 as Mistral. The controlling statement is: Q9 uses strain Nimbus.
Watering rows list 20, 28, and 36 hours for Q8, Q9, and Q10 respectively. Q9 is watered every 28 hours.
Steward rows name Sol Reed for Q8, Inez Quill for Q9, and Bo Chen for Q10. Q9 has primary steward Inez Quill.
A draft ledger put Q9 in Bed Gamma with strain Cirrus; the draft was rejected.
Inez Quill is backup steward for Q10, which remains on a 36-hour cadence.
Bed Delta irrigation hardware is inspected every 20 hours; that is not the seed watering cadence.
